discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_18/section_18.10/cis_18.10.9.x.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS` and Audit control `section_18/cis_18.10.9.x/cis_18.10.9.3.8.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

The role applies this only when its BitLocker option is turned on.

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "18.10.9.3.8 | PATCH | Ensure 'Choose how BitLocker-protected removable drives can be recovered: Configure storage of BitLocker recovery information to AD DS:' is set to 'Enabled: Backup recovery passwords and key packages'"
  when:
    - win11cis_rule_18_10_9_3_8
    - win11cis_bitlocker
  tags:
    - level1-bitlocker
    - level2-bitlocker
    - bitlocker
    - patch
    - automated
    - rule_18.10.9.3.8
    - removable_data_drives
    - recovery
  ansible.windows.win_regedit:
    path: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\FVE
    name: RDVActiveDirectoryInfoToStore
    data: 1
    type: dword
